name: 🚪KICK THE DOOR [⚡]
desc:
🦵 Kick The Door! 🚪💥
Get ready to unleash chaos and laughter in Kick The Door!
Sneak around a giant house, kick the door, and mess with other players before the monster finds you! 👀😱

Hide, troll, or bait your friends into danger — the choice (and the chaos) is yours!
Will you be the ultimate prankster or the next one caught? 💀

🎮 Fun & chaotic gameplay
😂 Troll your friends and make them scream
👹 Beware the angry monster inside
🧠 Simple, funny, and endlessly replayable!

💥 Kick. Hide. Troll. Survive.
It’s Kick The Door — where every knock could be your last! 🔓🚪
